about: Dishes the Slate iPhone app has and this site has no page for. Same format and rules as data/foods.json (recipes in grams, values from data/ingredients.json, cross-checks that need a stated range past 15%), without the page copy. node scripts/build.mjs computes the portions and writes research/app-food-sources.md; scripts/export-app.mjs sends them to the app.

recipe.yieldNote: fruit as eaten

judgement: Pulp weight: Alphonso 195 g (74.7% pulp), Langra 210 g (74.9%) and Dashehari 104 g (71.1%) in a 2018 Jharkhand trial; the average pulp is 125.63 g. Mangoes vary a lot: a Dashehari has about 74 g of pulp, a Langra about 157 g.
Values are the average of IFCT's seven ripe mango varieties.
